$summary: Elevation roles — how far a surface floats above the page. The one non-colour family that still branches by scheme: a light-mode shadow opacity barely registers against a dark canvas.

theme.elevation.raised.summary: Shadow for content that is part of the page but sits slightly above it.

theme.elevation.overlay.summary: Shadow for a transient surface anchored to a trigger.

theme.elevation.modal.summary: Shadow for a surface that takes over the screen.
